intro.text: Red Kite HR Services provides all the benefits of an in-house professional with the flexibility of an expert consultant. Our HR Consultancy specialist offers reliable, personalised, practical HR support with clear direction to work seamlessly with internal management.

overview.heading: HR consultancy
overview.text: Red Kite HR Services is an independent HR consultancy based in Sudbury, providing professional and legal solutions to your human resources issues. Working in partnership with businesses, we get to know your business and help leadership teams understand how to achieve their targets for business growth and communicate them to wider audiences and employees.

services.heading: Our HR
services.intro: HR issues in companies can be wide-reaching and harm your business. We collaborate with your organisation to ensure the HR strategy aligns with your business's core objectives and principles. Our strategic HR consultants can help with specific one-off problems, HR projects and ongoing support.

testimonial.quote: The support we get from Lydia and the team gives us the confidence that we are doing the right thing legally and in the interests of our staff. We are in a position where we know our HR processes are robust and compliant.
testimonial.name: Dave Jackson

closing.text: Our HR consultancy will support you and your business by aligning your HR services with your business strategy and operational plans. Working together, we ensure that we understand your workforce needs and objectives to future-proof your business and solve human resources problems.

button.title: Contact our senior consultants to future-proof your business
